tools.name: update_course_lesson_content
tools.description: Updates the title, body text, and estimated duration of an existing lesson in a course, and records the change time in the lesson's row.

params.name: lesson_id
params.description: ID of the lesson to update

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

LMS_DATABASE_PATH = "lms.db"


def update_course_lesson_content(lesson_id: int, new_title: str, new_body_text: str, new_duration_minutes: int) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(LMS_DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        current_timestamp_iso_string = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        update_cursor_result = database_connection.execute(
            "UPDATE lessons SET title = ?, body_text = ?, duration_minutes = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (
                new_title.strip(),
                new_body_text,
                new_duration_minutes,
                current_timestamp_iso_string,
                lesson_id,
            ),
        )
        number_of_rows_changed = update_cursor_result.rowcount
        database_connection.commit()
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

    if number_of_rows_changed == 0:
        return {"updated": False, "error": "Lesson not found", "lesson_id": lesson_id}
    return {
        "updated": True,
        "lesson_id": lesson_id,
        "updated_at": current_timestamp_iso_string,
    }

tools.name: record_quiz_attempt_grade
tools.description: Records a final score for a student's quiz attempt, marks the attempt as graded, and updates the student's best score and completion status for that quiz in the enrollment progress.

params.name: attempt_id
params.description: ID of the quiz attempt to grade

params.name: grader_notes
params.description: Optional feedback saved with the attempt

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from datetime import datetime, timezone

LMS_DATABASE_PATH = "lms.db"


def record_quiz_attempt_grade(attempt_id: int, score_percent: float, grader_notes: str = "") -> dict:
    if score_percent < 0 or score_percent > 100:
        return {"ok": False, "error": "score_percent must be between 0 and 100"}

    graded_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

    with closing(sqlite3.connect(LMS_DATABASE_PATH)) as connection:
        connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        with connection:
            attempt_row = connection.execute(
                "SELECT a.id, a.student_id, a.quiz_id, q.passing_score, q.course_id "
                "FROM quiz_attempts a JOIN quizzes q ON q.id = a.quiz_id WHERE a.id = ?",
                (attempt_id,),
            ).fetchone()
            if attempt_row is None:
                return {"ok": False, "error": "Attempt not found"}

            connection.execute(
                "UPDATE quiz_attempts SET score = ?, status = 'graded', grader_notes = ?, graded_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (score_percent, grader_notes, graded_at, attempt_id),
            )

            best_row = connection.execute(
                "SELECT MAX(score) AS best FROM quiz_attempts "
                "WHERE student_id = ? AND quiz_id = ? AND status = 'graded'",
                (attempt_row["student_id"], attempt_row["quiz_id"]),
            ).fetchone()
            best_score = best_row["best"]
            passed = 1 if best_score >= attempt_row["passing_score"] else 0

            connection.execute(
                "INSERT INTO quiz_progress (student_id, quiz_id, best_score, passed, updated_at) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) "
                "ON CONFLICT(student_id, quiz_id) DO UPDATE SET "
                "best_score = excluded.best_score, passed = excluded.passed, updated_at = excluded.updated_at",
                (attempt_row["student_id"], attempt_row["quiz_id"], best_score, passed, graded_at),
            )

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "attempt_id": attempt_id,
        "best_score": best_score,
        "passed": bool(passed),
    }
